text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is so pathetic...! At this rate, 
spreading the word about feng shui is out 
of the question...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Still, sulking around will only bring 
my luck down even further...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep my head up and keep moving 
forward properly...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right, efforts to improve your luck 
don't pay off right away. Even if the 
results aren't immediately visible, 
keeping at it is what matters!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Training's the exact same way, right! 
We've gotta keep working hard consistently 
toward the next race!"
choice_data_list:
Still, first of all, you need a reward for 
your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see, rewarding yourself is 
important too, huh. This is another 
fortune-boosting action!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well then~, I wanna eat something yummy 
today! Trainer, take me out~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Above all else, aligning the qi 
within yourself is what's important!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Pump yourself up and keep looking straight 
ahead! Let's do our best to spread even 
more happiness!
